audience: developers and search teams that run a Typesense search server

useCases.title: Search a collection with filters
useCases.text: Run a typo-tolerant search with filters, sorting and facets, or run several searches in one request.

useCases.title: Explore a collection schema
useCases.text: List the collections with their fields and document counts, then read the settings of one collection.

useCases.title: Review synonyms, curations and aliases
useCases.text: Read the synonym sets, curation sets and aliases that shape the results of a search.

useCases.title: Correct the fields of one document
useCases.text: Read a document by id, then change some of its fields. The other fields stay as they are.

useCases.title: Load documents into a new collection
useCases.text: Create a collection with a field schema, then upsert documents into it. A retry replaces the same document.
